purpose: Prospective untouched confirmation of the frozen final K8 organ-specialization reconstruction effect.

evidence_boundary.reason_not_frozen_executable: Membership/QC semantics and the total-parameter-matched generic K8 control require explicit scientific review.

resolved_source_contract.source: ARCHS4 human gene-level v2.latest / reported ARCHS4 version 2.7

resolved_model_contract.candidate: final frozen K8 package, not the adaptive K4 development branch

recommended_membership_contract_for_revi.pre_expression_candidate_membership: All 23,975 rows in the hash-bound eligible_metadata parquet, unless a separately frozen metadata-only manual review is completed before expression access.

post_expression_qc.only_allowed_exclusion: fewer than 14,000 nonzero genes under the frozen canonical extraction contract

recommended_minimum_qc_passing_coverage.justification: Eight study units matches the original frozen design target; fifty samples is below the prior smallest retained organ except liver and is a feasibility floor rather than an outcome-derived power claim.

recommended_membership_contract_for_revi.recommended_failure_behavior: If any frozen organ misses either coverage minimum after deterministic QC, stop before efficacy scoring and report cohort infeasibility; do not drop the organ or redefine the aggregate.

recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.expression_space: log1p TPM under the original frozen extraction and normalization order
recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.target_panel: the original 4,634 frozen score genes, all masked before every prediction
recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.negative_control: random_k8 using the already frozen GTEx-calibration assignments
recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.capacity_attribution_control: total-parameter-matched generic K8; exact construction and checkpoints do not yet exist
recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.primary_estimand: sample MSE averaged within connected series value, equal connected-series weight within organ, then equal organ weight
recommended_evaluation_contract_for_revi.uncertainty: 10,000 paired connected-series bootstrap draws within organ
recommended_confirmation_gate: blind hard routing improves versus pooled in each fixed seed
the all-seed aggregate paired-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero in the beneficial direction
no frozen organ has more than 2% relative MSE harm versus pooled
true-organ and soft-routing results are reported without replacing the primary hard-routing decision
random K8 does not pass the same specialization gate

two_stage_freeze_recommendation.stage_1_now: Freeze scientific design, metadata membership, QC decision tree, model package, target panel, estimand, gates, and control definitions without expression access.
two_stage_freeze_recommendation.stage_2_before_expression: After the separately authorized generic-K8 control is trained only on frozen GTEx development data, bind its checkpoints plus the final evaluator and launcher hashes in a no-choice execution manifest.

decisions_requiring_review: Confirm final K8, rather than the older selected K4-EPE development model, as the Track A target.
Choose all mechanically eligible catalog rows versus a metadata-manually-curated fixed subset before expression access.
Confirm that deterministic post-expression QC may produce the final scored membership even though only pre-QC candidate membership can be hash-bound now.
Confirm the eight-series and fifty-sample per-organ feasibility minima and fail-whole-confirmation behavior.
Decide whether the missing total-parameter-matched generic K8 is mandatory for Track A confirmation or a separately labeled attribution experiment.
Approve a two-stage freeze in which scientific choices are immutable now and execution/checkpoint hashes are added later without reopening those choices.
Confirm blind hard routing versus pooled as the single primary deployable claim and the proposed all-seed/bootstrap/per-organ safety gate.
execution_blockers: Claude/user decision signoff on the seven review items
exact final metadata membership manifest and SHA256
frozen generic-K8 decision and, if mandatory, checkpoint SHA256 by seed
final evaluator source SHA256 and implementation commit
prohibited_until_all_blockers_clear: ARCHS4 expression access for any catalog candidate
